index.description: Prepare menus week by week. A scheduled menu is published to parents automatically.
index.items_count: {count, plural, =0 {No dish} one {# dish} other {# dishes}}

builder.from_settings: Values from the settings, editable for this week.
builder.recipients: {count, plural, =0 {No active family has an active child yet.} one {On publication, # family receives an email and a notification.} other {On publication, # families receive an email and a notification.}}
builder.recipients_no_email: {count, plural, =0 {No active family has an active child yet.} one {On publication, # family receives a notification (emails are off in the settings).} other {On publication, # families receive a notification (emails are off in the settings).}}

edit_rule.until_cutoff: {days, plural, one {Until {time} the day before} other {Until {time}, # days before}}

builder.ready_detail: {count, plural, one {# open day} other {# open days}}, one default dish each day — ready to schedule.
builder.published_notice: Published menu: you can still add dishes. Removing a dish from a published menu is not possible yet (handling the affected orders comes next).
builder.scheduled_notice: Scheduled menu: it will be published automatically on {date}.
builder.closed_notice: Week over: the menu is read-only.
builder.day_summary: {meals, plural, =0 {No dish} one {# dish} other {# dishes}} · {supplements, plural, =0 {no supplement} one {# supplement} other {# supplements}}
builder.not_school_day_detail: This is not a school day.
builder.items_on_closed_day: These dishes are on a closed day: remove them.
builder.catalog_hint: Drag a meal onto a day to add it, or use “Add” in the day's column.
builder.copy_confirm_body: The dishes of the previous week replace this week's. Holidays and inactive meals are skipped.
builder.publish_confirm_body: Parents will see the menu and ordering opens. Families receive an email and a notification.
builder.unschedule_confirm_body: The automatic publication is cancelled until the menu is scheduled again.
builder.templates_apply_hint: The template replaces this week's dishes (draft only). Holidays and inactive meals are skipped.
builder.template_delete_body: The template “{name}” will be deleted. Existing menus don't change.
builder.templates_save: Save this week as a template
builder.replace_only_draft: Only available for a draft menu.
builder.report_added: {count, plural, =0 {No dish added.} one {# dish added.} other {# dishes added.}}
builder.report_new_default: {day}: the original default dish was skipped, the first remaining dish became the default.

issues.missing_times: Set the publication date and the order deadline.
issues.deadline_before_publish: The order deadline must be after the publication.
issues.deadline_after_week: The order deadline must be before the end of the week.
issues.no_open_day: Add meals to at least one open day (not a holiday).
issues.missing_default: {day} has no default dish: it is served to subscribed children who chose nothing by the deadline.
issues.items_on_closed_day: {day} is closed (holiday or outside the school year): remove its dishes.
issues.meal_unavailable: {day}: a meal is no longer active; remove it or reactivate it in the catalog.

errors.closed: This menu is closed and can no longer change.
errors.date_outside_week: This day is not in this week.
errors.not_school_day: This day is not a school day.
errors.holiday: This day is a holiday ({name}): no meal can be added.
errors.meal_unavailable: This meal is not available (inactive or deleted).
errors.duplicate: This meal is already on that day's menu.
errors.remove_published: This menu is published: a dish can't be removed from it yet, because parents may have ordered it. Add another dish instead, or contact the technical team.
errors.default_supplement: Only a subscription dish can be the default.
errors.no_previous_week: The previous week has no menu to copy.
errors.not_draft: Only a draft menu can be replaced (move it back to draft first).
errors.empty_week: This week has no active dish to save.
errors.template_name_taken: A template already has this name.
errors.times_locked: The times can no longer change: the menu is already published.
errors.deadline_before_publish: The order deadline must be after the publication.
errors.deadline_after_week: The order deadline must be before the end of the week.
errors.invalid_transition: This status change is not possible.
errors.not_ready: {count, plural, one {The menu is not ready: # thing to fix.} other {The menu is not ready: # things to fix.}}
errors.week_over: This week is over: its menu can no longer be scheduled or published.
errors.publish_in_past: The publication must be in the future (otherwise the menu would be published right away, unchecked): change the publication time.
errors.publish_too_early: The publication must be at most {weeks} weeks before the menu's week.
